title: Path-Based Sensors: Paths as Sensors, Bayesian Updates, and Shannon Information Gathering

stated_gaps.text: Robot-destroying hazards are invisible; only survival of a whole path is observed, so the location of destruction is unknown
stated_gaps.quote: if a robot is destroyed, then we have no idea where, along the path, its destruction has occurred

stated_gaps.text: Losing a robot also loses the information it would have gathered about victims/targets
stated_gaps.quote: new information about victims is lost whenever a robot is destroyed

stated_gaps.text: Hazard is binary (destroy/survive) per path; no cumulative, graded dose budget or ability to withdraw before failure

thesis_relevance: Closest conceptual ancestor of budget-limited robot loss; the thesis replaces binary destruction with a cumulative dose budget, predicted exposure and a withdraw action.

title: Learning about physical parameters: the importance of model discrepancy

stated_gaps.text: Ignoring model discrepancy gives biased, overconfident parameter estimates
stated_gaps.quote: an analysis that does not account for model discrepancy may lead to biased and over-confident parameter estimates and predictions

stated_gaps.text: Discrepancy is confounded with calibration parameters; only meaningful priors resolve it
stated_gaps.quote: being confounded with calibration parameters, which will only be resolved with meaningful priors

stated_gaps.text: GP discrepancy fixes predictions in data range but true parameters need realistic priors
stated_gaps.quote: only with realistic priors on the model discrepancy do we uncover the true parameter values

thesis_relevance: Directly explains the thesis's overconfident filter under spatially correlated model error and suggests a GP discrepancy term in the likelihood.

title: A decentralized control policy for adaptive information gathering in hazardous environments

stated_gaps.text: Hazards at unknown positions cause robots to fail (binary failure model)
stated_gaps.quote: avoiding hazards at unknown positions that cause the robots to fail

stated_gaps.text: Hazards are separate from the targets; in the thesis the target itself is the hazard and exposure is cumulative

thesis_relevance: Multi-robot information gathering with robot loss supports the thesis framing, but its hazard is binary and unrelated to the target, not a dose budget tied to the source estimate.

title: Probabilistic Multi-Robot Gas Source Localization with Uncalibrated Sensors: A Distributed Estimation Approach

stated_gaps.text: Prior work assumes homogeneous sensors / simple noise models
stated_gaps.quote: these approaches often assume homogeneous sensors or rely on simple noise models, which limit their applicability in realistic scenarios

stated_gaps.text: Product-of-experts fusion assumes conditional independence between robot observations
stated_gaps.quote: this formulation assumes followed by normalization, that i=1 conditional independence between robot observations

stated_gaps.text: Reduce communication by sending incremental belief updates

stated_gaps.text: Existing methods rely on simplified plume models and fail in real patchy fields
